Definition: Kedemoth, a place in eastern Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Kedemoth is the wilderness where Moses sent messengers to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace. It is also a city given to the Merarites with her suburbs.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the wilderness and the city together as the two faces of the journey, the road and the rest.
